mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, 'CONTENT' AS reviewType, R.CONTENT_NO AS targetNo, C.TITLE AS title, C.POSTER_PATH AS thumbnail, R.RATING AS rating, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS content, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW R JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND R.STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, 'PRODUCT' AS reviewType, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS targetNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS title, (SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS thumbnail, PR.RATING AS rating, PR.CONTENT AS content, PR.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO WHERE PR.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW ( REVIEW_NO, MEMBER_NO, CONTENT_NO, RATING, REVIEW_TEXT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_REVIEW_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{contentNo}, #{rating}, #{reviewText}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, RATING AS rating, REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'

SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, RATING AS rating, REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_TEXT = #{reviewText}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEW ( REVIEW_NO, PRODUCT_NO, ORDER_ITEM_NO, MEMBER_NO, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO.NEXTVAL, #{productNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{memberNo}, #{rating}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RATING AS rating, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo}
